description: This file defines a StatefulWidget called MainTabs that manages bottom navigation across multiple pages (Tasks, Projects, Tags, Dashboard, Settings) within a Flutter app. It also contains a custom notification class for inter-widget communication.

classes.name: MainTabs
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that manages bottom navigation among various feature pages with dynamic app bar and FAB.

classes.name: _MainTabsState
classes.description: State class for MainTabs, manages current tab index and builds the UI based on selected tab.

classes.name: _TabInfo
classes.description: Immutable class encapsulating tab label, icon, and content widget.

classes.name: TasksFabTapNotification
classes.description: Notification class used to trigger FAB actions inside TasksPage from MainTabs.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for MainTabs.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the scaffold with app bar, body, FAB, and bottom navigation bar based on current tab index.

methods.name: _tabs
methods.description: Returns the list of tab information including title, icon, and content widget.
